title: Twicreakingly
html_source: The librarian is represented through the lens of Shakespeare and the analysis of Shakespeare. Literature is directing literature.

anchor.prefix: o, albeit lingering. The beautiful ineffectual dreamer who comes to grief against hard facts. One always feels that Goethe's judgments are so true. True in the larger analysis.
